posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
This is a thread for miscellaneous observations and inquiries about the art of SOTM.  I've been told before that rules questions should not go in a big unsorted thread, but since these aren't about the rules, hopefully not a big deal.

Today's question - what's going on with Trueshot's legs?  They have a burnished-metal tone which doesn't look natural and doesn't match the color of her face.  Is she wearing Lycra pants, or some sort of futuristic artificial tan, or maybe an alchemical preparation that toughens her skin into natural armor?

posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
I find the saddest one to be TL Tachyon. It's probably because she's my favorite and I've gotten so attached to her, but the sight of her in such intense pain that she's openly crying genuinely makes me tear up whenever I look at it for too long. Normally she just cringes in pain, but seeing her crying makes me really sad.

In terms of depressing, I get a major vibe of "Damn... that BLOWS" from Eternal Haka's incap side. I assume that what we're looking at is the remains of the library he swore to protect, so seeing him see the ruins of it makes me quite sad.
